description: Patch project metadata (name, lifecycle status, externalRef). Pass `projectId`, or `project` with the name the user said; with neither, the result lists their projects and nothing is written. preview=true returns the field-level diff and writes nothing. A write returns a receipt; undoOperationId restores the captured prior fields. Does not archive or delete.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

externalRef.description: Provenance of an imported project. Canonical form is `<system>:<id>` (e.g. `notion:<page-id>`). Unique per creator when set. Pass null to clear.

lifecycleStatus.description: Project stage. getProjectContext returns it as lifecycleStatus.

preview.description: When true, return the field-level diff and write nothing. Combined with undoOperationId, returns the stored receipt.

project.description: Project name to match, when you do not have the UUID. Case-insensitive; an exact name wins over a partial one. Matching more than one lists the candidates instead of guessing.

projectId.description: Project UUID. Omit if you pass `project`.

undoOperationId.description: Receipt id from a prior updateProject write. Restores the captured prior fields. With preview=true, inspects the receipt instead.

name: updateProject
title: Update project fields
